verdict.rationale: Pylon documents connecting external knowledge sources as training data, but nothing in the evidence says those sources re-sync on a schedule or when they change. The evidence that does mention syncing doesn't fit this story. The daily Salesforce scan pushes conversation summaries out to the CRM rather than refreshing agent knowledge. The product-data sync changelog entry concerns account data, not knowledge sources.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, knowledge stays current automatically — the agent re-syncs sources on a schedule or on change, not via manual re-uploads
